posts.zh:
dsh-autoresume 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。dsh web 重启后自动向被打断的会话注入「继续」，让 agent 自动接续干活；每进程只注入一次，不重复触发。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0cd52da5187cbc3921bf.html
posts.en:
dsh-autoresume is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-continue an interrupted dsh session after a web restart by injecting a "continue" follow-up; one-shot per process, no duplicate-injection loops.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0cd52da5187cbc3921bf.html
